_readme: Official National Day-period statistics. Every entry MUST have a real source. status=active can be shown publicly (the public page reveals up to 3 per visitor, closest to National Day first); status=reference is admin/AI-context only. Values were verified on 2026-09-27. The SAMA weekly POS for the National Day 96 week (20–26 Sep 2026) was not yet published at that date — add it from /admin when released (usually ~3 days after the week ends).
